tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa bdag gdon dgrol nyes pa kun sel phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo badzra pā ṇi ye/ gang gi mtshan brjod gzungs bsngags bzlas pa yis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag las byung sdug bsngal nad/ /gtan nas sel mdzad rje btsun seng ge'i sgra'i/ /zhabs sen gus mchod gdon dgrol cho ga bri/ / de la 'dir sa bdag gdon dgrol ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas nas 'chad pa la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las dang po ni/ gnas yid dang mthun pa gang yang rung bar/ ras shog sogs la gru bzhi sgo bzhi ba'i nang du chu ris sngon po dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa bris sa stegs kyi khar bkrams te/ dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'am tshom bu dgod/ de'i g.yas g.yon du zangs gzhong re re'am/ ma 'byor na shing snod gtsang ma'i nang du bag phye bsres pa'i zan nas/ ma grub na zan tsam las klu chen brgyad kyi gzugs bcos ma'am/ bar du btab pa 'og nas 'chad pa'i rim pa dang mthun par g.yas ngos kyi zangs gzhong nang dang*/ g.yon du snod kyi nang dus bdag rgyal po'i gzugs ri rab gru bzhi bskad bar bcad pa lta bu'i steng gi zur bzhir glang gi mgo bo bzhi bya/ de'i mthar khyung gla ba rma bya phag ma gtogs pa'i sems can gyi gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa byas te bskor/ gzhongs pa gnyis ka'i phyogs bzhir snyug ldaig btsugs pa dang ras dmar po'i 'phan dang cod pan dang*/ de dag gi bar bar du ras skud dmar po sogs kyi lda ldi bya'o/ /de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams ci 'byor dang*/ 'bul gtor pad 'dab can lnga bshams pa/ grub na thog mar theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong len cing*/ ma grub na kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas skyabs 'gro spyi ltar byas la/ / rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun seṅge'i sgrar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang rje btsun seṅge'i sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ gu ru sidha nā da sarba bo dhi satwa bhyaḥ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra ti tstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas shapta'i bar mchod de/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /nas 'grub par shog ces pa'i bar gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ badzra muḥtshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gnyis pa dngos bzhi la/ paṇa chen gyi der bdag mdun gnyis dus gcig tu lha drug bskyed mdzad de blos 'chun dka' bas lnga phyir byas na legs la/ lha drug bskyed ni bya ba spyi'i lugs sngags rim nas bshad pa ltar yin 'dug pas legs shing*/ bdag gis kyang sngar de bzhin du bkod zin la/ rgya gzhung du ma dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho rgya rtsa bod kyi sgrub thabs thor bu rnams las ni sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ cho ga gsum bskyed mdzad pa shin tu mang shing*/ khyad bar seṅge'i sgra'i sgrub thabs du ma las de ltar 'byung bas 'dir 'jug pa bde ched cho ga gsum bskyed bya ste de ni 'di ltar/ oṃ shū n+ya ta nas atma ko3haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgya dpa'i lte bar/ paṃ las padma dmar po'i lte bar sing las seṅge dkar po mgo bo g.yas phyogs su/ bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥyig dkar bo las padma dkar bo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ste ba la hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid rje btsun seṅge'i sgra sku mdog dkar bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sbyan gsum pa/ gzhon nu dka' thub pa'i tshul 'dzin cing*/ ral ba'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon pus mo'i rgyab ngos nas zla gdan la brten pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis padma'i rtsa ba nas bzung ba'i rtse mo gnyis su gyes pa'i steng na ye shes kyi ral gri dang*/

dri zhim po sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ sku'i g.yas su sbrul dkar po kha nas khrag 'dzag pas dkris pa'i rtse gsum zla gdan la btsugs pa/ ras skud dmar po'i tshangs skud dang*/ ras bzang bo'i sham thams gsol zhing*/ kṛṣṇa sa ra'i lpags pa nu ma g.yon pa la bkab pa/ sku las 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 'phro ba/ rgyal bo rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros po ta la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje bdun seṅge'i sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ oṃ ārya lo ke shwa ra sa ma raṃ wa ra badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa klu las pā ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba ta tā ga ta nas shrīḥye āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bos nas dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ padmanta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bha was stongs sbyangs/ stong ba'i dang las oṃ las rin po che'i snong yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ /oṃ arghaṃ aḥhūm̐ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ ārya si dha nā da sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā nas shapta'aṃ bar gyis mchod la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags shing*/ /yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba'i/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ dang*/ nam mo rad ṇa trā yā ya/ na mo ā rya a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā swa twa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ ta dya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭe ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe ka ro ṭe/ bidya swāhā/ zhes pa gnyis/ ci 'grub bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod pa sngar ltar mchod bstod dang dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed ni/ bsgrub gzhi padmatna kṛ ta kyis bsangs/ shū n+ya has stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zhes pa nas/ rgyal bo rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du baṃ las klu rgyal wa ru ṇa dkar bo gtso bo la gus bas 'dud cing bka' nod pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la phuḥbargyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ /lhor nor rgyas ser bo/ /nub tu 'jog po dmar bo/ byang du stobs rgyu nag po/ mer padma dkar bo/ bden bral du padma chen po dkar bo/ rlung du dung skyong dmar bo/ /dbang ldan du rigs ldan ljang khu ste/ thams cad stod lha'i lus can dang*/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ dbu la gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan cing*/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /de dag gi 'khor klu rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/

bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs/ gdol pa'i rigs rnams dang*/ sa bdag klu gnyan sa srin gyi rigs dang zha bo 'theng bo don snying yan lag gnas mal longs spyod nyams pa la sogs pa dang*/ lan chags bu lon sha khon can la sogs pa rnams kyis bskor ba de rnams kyi mthar 'od kyi ra bas bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar bo/ / zhes pa nas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe 'ong dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang gzhan sum khu tshur bcings pa'i mthe bong gi rgyab tu g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga phral te bzhag pa gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa sbyan drangs/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad cing*/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /gtsug na rin chen klu yi rje/ /mtha' yas nor rgyas dung skyong dang*/ /dga' bo 'jog po padma dang*/ /padma chen po chu lha dang*/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang ma dros dang*/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ / oṃ e hye hi/ sarba nā ga rā dza sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes pas klu dang*/ oṃ e hye hi/ sarba bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes pas sa bdag spyan drangs dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa klu la zhes pa nas yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ klu rgyal rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams thun mong du sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs bskyed de byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ni/

rab 'byams zhing na yod pa'i mchod tshogs dang*/ / bdag gis gus pas sbyar ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /rje btsun seṅge'i sgra dang klu chen brgyad/ /'khor dang bcas la 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ārya sidha nā da sarba nā ga ra dza sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas shupta' ི bar sbyar nas mchod la/ /skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ / zhes sogs dang*/ khams gsum sems can thams cad dang*/ /khyad par klu gnyan sa bdag gi /nad dang sdug bsngal kun sel ba'i/ /seṅge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ces bas bstod/ de rnams bdag la/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ klu gnyan sa bdag la thun mong du klu sman rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags sam oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la 'di ltar/ nā ga ge ser sman gyi mchog /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ /ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i brdas bkrol te/ /klu chen brgyad la mchod par 'bul/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dran dgongs la/ /zhe sdang gdug las slar 'thul cig /ka ṇā ka ri na ga pul pa dang*/ /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba chu srin sder mo dang*/ /dbang bo lag pa bal po se'u dang*/ /spu shel rtse dang dmar bshad lcag ma dang*/ /gur gum utpal 'dam bu'i nags tshal dang*/ /dar tshon sna lnga ras skud dmar bo dang*/ /li khri dmar bo ga phur shol dang ni/ /shu thag dkar bo snying po zho sha dang*/ /mkhal ma zho sha stag gi shun pa dang*/ /tsandan dkar dmar klu sman sna tshogs kyis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag rnams la mchod par bgyi/ /bzhes nas yon bdag nad 'di bsal du gsol/ / ces mchod de/ klu rnams la bstod pa ni/ mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams/ /yid bzhin rgya mtsho chen po'i yangs pa na/ /yid 'ong rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /pho brang 'byor ba chen po'i dbus na bzhugs/ /dbu la sbrul mgo'i gdengs kas mdzes pa'i dbus/

/yid bzhin nor bu bsam pa rdzogs byed cing*/ /bdag gzhan don rnams phun tshogs 'grub pa'i gter/ / dbul ba'i mun sel 'od 'bar rnams kyis brgyan/ /gdengs can 'byor ba'i tshogs rnams thams cad rdzogs/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /klu dbang 'khor dang bcas la gus pas 'dud/ / ces bstod/ grub na skabs 'dir gtso bo dang klu brgyad kyi sngags ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ /de nas gtor ma rnams so so'i thun mong du bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rts-i'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum oṃ swa bhā wa bi shangnghe zhes sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ / mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyis sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ gtor ma dang po/ / oṃ ārya sidha nā da sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtso bo dang*/ gnyis pa/ oṃ wa ru ṇa/ a nanta/ ba su ka ta kṣa ka a ko ṭa/ padma/ ma hā padma/ sharṣa pā la/ kū li ka sa pa ri wa ri i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis klu chen brgyad dang*/ yang na aṣṭha ma hā nā ga sa pā ri wa ras thun mong du 'bul rung ngo*/ /gsum pa oṃ nā ga kū la pañtsa sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ sogs klu rigs lnga dang*/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ sogs kyis gnyan dang sa bdag la phul nas/ klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas sogs/ /rigs lnga'i klu tshogs ma lus dang*/ khyad par sbyin bdag la 'tshe ba'i/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad la/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rin chen sna lnga klu yi gter/ /klu sman dar zab sna tshogs dang*/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i dam rdzas rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yin/

/byin gyis brlabs te 'bul lags na/ /phyogs bcu'i klu yi pho brang du/ /bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bab gyur cig / bzhi ba bgegs la bsngo ba ni/ / oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ bi tsi bi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sa pā ri wa ra a ka ro'i na maḥ sogs lan gsum gyis phul te/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*/ /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang*/ /byas pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang*/ /khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs la/ /'bul gyis bzhes la deng phan chad/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa mi byed cing*/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor gtan bor te/ /bsam pa byang chub sems bskyed mdzod/ / lnga ba gzhi bdag la bsngo ba ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra oṃ lan gsum/ / phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ yul lha bzhi bdag rnams la bsngo/ /bzhes nas las dang bya ba gang*/ /byas la phrag dog mi mdzad par/ /mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub bar mdzod/ / bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs kyang brjod do/ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba'i bum pa dang*/ rtsi sman gyi bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul 'ching gzungs thag dang bcas pa sta gon byas te gla rtsi ma 'dres pa'i bum rdzas dri bzang bo'i chu dang bcas pas dgang*/ rtsi sman gyi bum par 'og nas 'byung ba'i gso ba'i sman rnams las cung zad re blug ste ra dkar dang ba dmar gyi 'o ma dri chu dang bcas pa bkang dbang bskur ba'i bum pa sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/

stong ba'i dang las bhruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zhes pa nas rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du baṃ las klu rgyal wa ru ṇa dkar bo zhes pa nas/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ klu rgyal rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar bya/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ā rya sidha nā da sarba nā ga rā dzā bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta pra ti tstsha hūm̐ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod la/ / thugs rje'i gter gyur rje btsun seṅge'i sgra/ /klu chen brgyad dang sa bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnal 'byor sbyin bdag gi /'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bas sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ / gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gang mang dang*/ grub na bzungs ring kyang 'don/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye nā ga rā dza hūm̐ nāṃ hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ a nanta ye nā ga rā dza hūm̐ nāṃ hūm̐ swāhā/ de thog mtha' de bzhin du sbyar te/ ba su ki/ takṣa ka a ko ṭa/ padma/ ma hā padma/ shaṅkha pā la/ kū li ka ye nā ga rā dzā hūm̐ nāṃ hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pa rnams klu brgyad kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ nā ga kū la pañtsa shanti swāhā/ oṃ nā ga pra ti bo ya swāhā/ oṃ nā ga pra bhañtsa pu nye pa swāhā/ oṃ ta thā ga ti hrīḥta hūm̐ swāhā/ ces pa klu rigs bzhi 'am lnga'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla'o/ /de nas gzungs thag rtse sman gyi bum pa'i steng du spos pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun dang gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṣa singngha lo tsa ni sarba antha sangngha ni swāhā

shi sos par byed pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ de bya a mṛ ta nan ta ra bhi sha me ta pra tī tstsha bas nan na ma swāhā/ / zhes pa sman bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla'o/ /sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /sman rnams 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i bden pa des/ /nad pa rnams kyi nad gsos shing*/ /sman rnams bdun rtsir 'gyur par shog/ ces bden pa'i byin brlab bya/ nad pa'i mdun klu dang sa bdag gi gzugs 'gros bcug pa'i snod de bzhag la/ de'i mdun du dkar gsum mngar gsum dang klu snam dang mchod pa gtor ma dang bcas pa tshar gnyis bsham/ bgegs gtor sha chang la phug dang bcas pas brgyan pa bshams te 'di skad ces/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi gzugs 'gros 'di rnams klu gnyan sa bdag de dang de dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ glang mgo can 'di sa bdag nag po dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ /klu dang sa bdag de dag gi 'khor du khyed cag la gnod pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs rnams kyis bskor ba'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces brda' sbrad nas sngar ltar gdengs ka'i phyag rgya byas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa sbyan drangs/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ / zhes pa nas/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces pa'i sngar bzhin bya zhing dbang bskur rgyas 'debs sogs byas kyang mi 'gal/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ sngar ltar ram bsdu na/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis 'bul nas sngags kyi mthar arghaṃ sogs sbyar nas mchod/ rgya mtsho chen por dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /gtso bo klu chen brgyad pa dang*/ /sa chen 'di la gnas bcas pa'i/ /sa bdag 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ khyed rnams mchod cing bstod byas pas/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor kun zhi zhing*/ /bsam pa byang chub sems ldan pas/

/sbyin bdag srung zhing skyob gyur cig/ ces brjod de nas rtsi sman gyi bum pa lag tu thog sa nas 'di skad ces/ rtsi sman gyi chu 'di nyid gzugs 'gros rnams la gtor bas klu gnyan sa bdag las byung ba'i gnod pa dang nad rnams sos/ de sos pa'i mthus khyed cag gi nad rnams sos pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces brda' sbrad nas gtso bo sngags dang*/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru sogs brjod cing bum chu gzugs 'gros rnams lan kha yang gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas/ hrīḥ nga ni thugs rje chen po ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /gso ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /zab mo sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ / bsreg dang btso ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ / bsnun cing btub pa'i sdug bsngal sogs/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba rnams/ /'chi med 'tsho ba'i sman rnams kyis/ /bsreg cing btso ba sos gyur cig /lus dang dbang po rgyas gyur cig /mthu stobs ldan zhing bde gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar shog /dga' dang byang chub sems ldan cing*/ /dbang bo rnams kyi spyod yul du/ /'dod rgu'i longs spyod ldan gyur cig /nyams pa'i lus sogs sos shing rgyas/ /yan lag tshang zhing bde gyur cig /klu nad thams cad sos gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar shog /ngan song gsum las yongs bral te/ /tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan gyur cig /chos spyod dbang bo dul gnas kyang*/ /seṅge'i sgra yi zhal mthong shog / sngags dang sman sogs byin brlabs gyis/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zhi gyur nas/ /bcings pa'i nad las grol bar mdzod/ /nā ga rā dzā phuḥshiṃnta ku ru swā hā/ bsdu na des chog la/ rgyas par 'dod na/ chag tshang ku ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /mgo bo nyams pa sos gyur cig /gze ma 'phang chen bdud rtsi yis/ /skra lo nyams pa= /mu tig shel go= /klad pa=

/spu shel rtse yi= /rna ba= khra bo gzi yi= spyan chag= rgya spos dri yi= sna ni= mgron bu dkar po'i= so ni= leb rgan dar gyi= ljags ni= bu ram bzang po'i= shi ni= snying po zho sha'i= don snying = rgya mtsho sbu ba'i= glo ba= gur gum dkar po'i= mchin pa= mkhal ma zho sha'i= mkhal ma= btsod mdud dmar po'i= rgyu ma= dbang bo lag pa'i= lag pa= chu srin sder mo'i= rkang ba= dung dkar g.yas 'khyil= rus pa= mtshal chen da chu'i= khrag ni= ras skud dmar po'i= tshe srog= rma bya'i mdongs kyi= bkrag mdangs= rin chen sna lnga'i= nor ni= 'bru sna lnga yi bdud rtsi yis/ /yul khams nyams pa sos gyur cig / ces dang sngags brjod cing rtsi sman gyi bum chu gzugs 'gros rnams la gtor/ de nas 'phrin las bcol zhing 'dod don gsol ba ni// // kyai klu chen brgyad dang klu rigs bzhi/ /klu bdud klu btsan thams cad dang*/ /sa bdag sa srin la sogs pa/ /khyed rnams la ni mchod gtor tshogs/ /phul nas 'phrin las bcol ba la/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag kun/ /bya ba mang zhing spyod rtsing bas/ /sa brkos brag bshig na slog cing*/ /rdo bcag chu dkrugs shing rnams bcad/ /mi gtsang thab gzhob byas gyur pas/ /klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyi/ /lus dang yan lag don snying dang*/ /dbang po longs spyod nyams pa dang*/ /thugs dang spyan zur la phog pa'i/ /nyes pa thams cad sos gyur cig /de ltar gsos pas khyed rnams kyi/ /mthong dug reg dug mche ba'i dugakha rlangs dug dang sbyar dug gis/ /bskyed pa'i mdze 'bras shu ba dang*/ /phol mig bas ldag g.yan pa dang*/ /me dbal dreg grum rkang 'bam/ /dmu chu la sogs nad rnams kun/ /mi 'byung zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang*/ gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bya te dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni 'jig rten dbang phyug ste/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /chos bshad bden tshig nyan par gyis/ /gal te bden tshig mi nyan na/

/rig sngags rgyal bo'i bka' bcag pas/ /gso ba'i sman rnams thams cad kun/ /mtshon cha'i char du gyur nas ni/ /lus kyi gnad la gzer bar byed/ /bcad cing bcad cing dum bur 'gyur/ /mngar gsum la sogs gtor ma yang*/ /dug chen ha la ha lar gyur/ /smyo dang rmongs par gyur nas ni/ /tsha ba chen pos gzir bar byed/ /des na dus rnams thams cad du/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu srungs/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha ha nā da sa ma ya rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de dam la bzhag go /de nas dbang bum gyi nang gi gtso bos dbang bskur bar bsams la gzungs ring thung gi rjes su/ sarba nā ga duḥkha pra sha ma na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis klu la dbang bskur/ yang gzungs kyi mjug tu/ sarba nā kū la pañtsa duḥkha pra sha ma na ye a bhi ṣiñtsha/ zhes pas klu rigs bzhi 'am lnga dang*/ yang de'i 'phror/ sarba bhu mi pa ti duḥkha pra sha ma na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa sa bdag rnams la dbang bskur bas dgyes nas srung slob byed par bsam mo/ /de nas dbang bum gyi chus lha la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / tshigs bcad ci rigs gyis phus gsol byas te chu bum pa nyid du blugs nas bsgrub bya la khrus bya ba dang*/ gtsug na yid bzhin nor bu can/ /mig ni gdeng ba lto 'phye'i rigs/ /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyur zhig/ gtso bo'i sngags dang ru ru spu ru'i sngags brjod pa'i rjes la/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shinti ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ nad thams cad= rims thams cad= gdon= nye bar 'tshe ba= dus ma yin par 'chi ba= 'khon= grib = byad dang byur thams cad= skal ba ngan pa= rmi ltas dang mtshan ma ngan pa= mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon= bdud kyi zhags pa= gshin rje'i pho nya= bgegs dang log 'dren= lo skag zla skag zhag skag dus skag sogs mdor na bkra mi shis pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/

lus can mgo bo tha dad la/ /zhe sdang drag po rgyal po'i rigs/ /rigs bzhi klu brgyad yid kyi dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung zhig /gshed la gnas pa 'dzangs pa'i= gtsang ma phal la gnod mi byed/ /klu bran 'bum sde reg pa'i dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams= zhe sdang gnag pa byol song rigs/ /rmig bzhi lcags la na bun 'thab/ /gnyan chen 'bum sde kha rlangs dug /bzod dka'i dug= dman pa'i cha 'dzin zhe sdang can/ /bden pa mi nyan kun la gnod/ /sa bdag sdig bzhi mche ba'i dug /bzod dka'i dug= dreg pa sde brgyad 'bar ba yi/ /glen pa nga rgyal mthu po che/ /'gro ba 'di la gang gnod pa/ /bzod dka'i dug= sbyor gzhan rab tu 'phros pa'i pho nya ni/ /sprul ba 'bum sdes 'gro la gnod pa skyel/ /sman dang sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /bzod dka' mi zad dug= phyung zhig /ces brjod cing bkru'o/ /byabs ni khar chu cung zad bzung ste/ /rma bya'i mdongs kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa ces sngags me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer kyis sngar bkrus pas ma dag pa'i nad gdon rnams byab zhing ded nas kha nang gi chu la thim par gyur/ de nas gong ltar shantiṃ ku ru'i gnas su a pa na ye swāhā zhes sbyar bas bya ba ste mthar kha'i chu bkrus ba'i chu nang du 'dor ro/ /srung ba ni/ khyed kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rje rgya 'gram du bzhag pas rdo rje go bskon te phyin chad gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par gyur ces brda sprad nas rdo rje de bzhin du bzhag la ngag tu sngags dang sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las srung zhing rakṣa rakṣa ye swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan la sbyar nas brjod cing*/ seṅge'i sgra'i sngags bzlas pa'i srung skud dkar bo btags te/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin brlabs dang*/ /rje btsun seṅge'i sgra yi thugs rje yis/

/'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā de nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi= khyad par du'ang rje btsun seng ge'i sgra'i thugs rje dang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang klu'i rgyal bo rnams kyi mthu dang bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams klu gnyan sa bdag gi gnod pa dang nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig /dza ya dza ya/ singnghi singnghi/ pha la pha la hoḥ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs dang*/ nyin mo bde sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o/ /de nas bgegs gtor kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs la/ gong ltar oṃ gung ka ri nas/ sa pa ri wa ri a kā ro'am na maḥ sogs kyis phul te/ sngar ltar ram spro na/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ / zhes sogs brjod cing*/ / de'i tshe'i sa bdag don kun rang gnas dengs/ / zhes bsgyur yang na snga ma ltar byas te/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol gyi mjug tu/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra badzra muḥs bdag 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur ces brjod cing se gol gdab po/ /de nas/ da ni klu rnams gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal rigs dkar bo shar du gshegs/ /bram ze ser po lho ru gshags/ /rje rigs dmar po nub du gshegs/ /dmangs rigs sngon po byang du gshegs/ /gdol ba nag po 'tshams su gshegs/ /sa yi bdag po sa la gshegs/ /rdo yi bdag po rdo la gshegs/ /chu yi bdag po chu la gshegs/ /shing gi bdag po shing la gshegs/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ /sarba nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra badzra muḥklu rgyal 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing gshegs/ de nas slob dpon gyis bum chu 'thor zhing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas bgegs gtor klu dang sa bdag gi gzugs gtor ma rnams rim pa bzhin du bsrus nas brdzangs te/

gzugs brnyan rnams ni chu bo chen por dor te bya khyis mi za bar bya'o/ /mthar 'gro ba'i tshe 'od kyi rab dgrol bar bsams shing*/ nang du slebs pa dang mdun bskyed la btang rag gi mchod bstod bzod gsol dang*/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol gsol gdab bsngo smon shis brjod rnams bya'o/ /zhes sa bdag gdon dgrol ji ltar bya ba'i tshul 'di ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba yin yang*/ der bdag mdun mnyam du mdzad pa ni gzhan gyis blos 'chun dka' bar ma zad/ de'i rkyen gyis 'khrugs bsdebs dgos pa mang du snang zhing*/ de blo chung gzhan gyis byed dka' bas phyag len dngos gtsang gi 'od 'bar mthong nas bdag gis 'di'i cho ga zhig sngar bris zin kyang 'dir slar yang bar du brko ched 'khrugs bsdebs dang kha skong dgos pa 'ga' re snang ba rnams byas te cho ga gsum bskyed ma gtogs/ gzhan de bzhin du shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can kyis rje btsun gyi 'phrin las spel ba dang snyigs dus kyi mi rnams spyod pa ngan pa'i dbang gis sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa mang du 'byung bar bshad pas/ de dag la yang phan na snyam pa'i bsam pas co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i par yig pa dge slong bkra shis so/ /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/sa bdag gdon dgrol nyes pa kun sel phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 330-- PAGE 331-- PAGE 318-
